meta.geography: U.S. Census Bureau 2020 ZIP Code Tabulation Area (ZCTA) to Place relationship file, with 2020 Gazetteer internal points for distance.
meta.note: A ZCTA approximates a USPS ZIP Code. It is not a USPS ZIP Code. A city match means about half or more of the ZCTA land area is inside that Census place. Distance is straight-line miles between Census internal points, not drive time. This file has no storage prices.
